A quick reminder for anyone travelling with a pet.

Pet travel notice

Travelers need to know that pets and reptiles must be checked with the Companion Animal Travel Desk before you head to the skyport. This helps us make sure your animal has the right carrier, paperwork, and calm handling from start to finish. Aurelia Skyways wants the trip to feel smooth for you and gentle for your companion.

If you are bringing a cat, please read the carrier guidance carefully. <<FACT F067>> Keep the crate secure, clean, and easy for staff to inspect. For reptile travel, the pet must also meet the age rule before booking is confirmed. <<FACT F078>> Our team will help you sort out the details so there are no surprises at the counter.

Please stop by the Companion Animal Travel Desk before departure, and we will guide you through the next steps.
